page: Microsoft Azure L32aos_v4 is a storage-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Laosv4 family, powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 9V74 processor. Operating on the x86_64 architecture under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this server features 32 vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The CPU runs at a clock speed of 3.7 GHz and is equipped with 32 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache. It includes advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 (including VNNI and BF16) and cryptographic acceleration via AES and SHA_NI. The hardware configuration is completed by 256.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core, and a massive 23,038 GB local NVMe SSD storage array.

In benchmark evaluations, the L32aos_v4 demonstrates strong single-core performance, scoring in the top 25% for stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core tests. Multi-threaded performance is also robust, with bzip3 multi-threaded decompression and Geekbench multi-core scores placing in the top tier. Cryptographic capabilities are highlighted by strong Passmark CPU encryption results. For artificial intelligence workloads, the server achieves strong prompt processing and text generation speeds on small (135M) language models, while maintaining average performance on medium (7B) and large (70B) models. Memory bandwidth and database operations, including Redis SET operations and Passmark database tests, consistently register in the average range.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the L32aos_v4 offers high resource density, combining substantial memory capacity with an exceptionally large local NVMe storage allocation on a single virtual machine. This dense hardware profile minimizes the need for external storage attachments, optimizing the cost-per-gigabyte ratio for storage-heavy deployments. The server is highly suited for large-scale relational and non-relational databases, data warehousing, high-throughput log analytics, and memory-intensive enterprise applications requiring rapid local read/write access.
description: Microsoft Azure L32aos_v4 is a high-capacity storage and memory-optimized virtual machine powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 9V74 processor. Featuring 32 vCPUs across 16 physical cores running at 3.7 GHz, the server is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM and an extensive 23,038 GB local NVMe SSD. Benchmark results indicate strong single-core and multi-core performance in Geekbench and stress-ng, alongside strong cryptographic execution and small-model LLM inference. Memory bandwidth, database operations, and static web serving throughput perform in the average tier. The massive local storage capacity and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio make this instance highly cost-efficient for data-dense environments, eliminating the need for external storage attachments. It is ideally suited for large-scale databases, data warehousing, big data analytics, and high-throughput transactional workloads.
